items.title: LTM's net profit jumps 17% to Rs 1,466 crore in Q1, revenue rises 18%
items.description: The company had posted a net profit of Rs 1,387.3 crore in the fourth quarter of the previous financial year.

items.title: Zetwerk backs AI robotics startup launched by co-founder Rahul Sharma, who moves to non-executive role
items.description: The startup will raise additional capital independently to fund its growth

items.title: DMart's standalone net profit up 12.8% in Q1 but mature store growth slows
items.description: On a consolidated basis, net profit increased 11.3 per cent to Rs 860.6 crore in the quarter, while revenue from operations increased 15 per cent to Rs 18,794.5 crore

items.title: FSSAI issues notices to Swiggy Instamart for allegedly delivering spoiled, expired food products
items.description: The regulator has directed the platform to submit a detailed explanation and compliance report failing which appropriate legal action will be initiated.
